output.summary: An endangered tree fern of mountain rainforests in East and Southeast Asia. In Japan, its new leaves and shoots are boiled to remove bitterness before being eaten, while its boiled core is a festival food on the Yaeyama and Ishigaki islands.
output.edibilityNote: Stem starch is eaten in China and Taiwan; Japan uses boiled young leaves and shoots, and boiled core as a regional festival food.
